submittedParameters.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Create ONE final independent traditional Chinese festival event banner for the Taoist fantasy game 五行奇谈.
Canvas: target native 2098 × 749 pixels, very wide landscape 2.8:1, opaque edge-to-edge illustration. Never a whole interface or a contact sheet.
Input image 1 is the PRIMARY approved style, chibi-character and horizontal-composition reference. Input image 2 is the approved mail interface context; use its painting quality only, never copy UI frames, borders, controls or writing.
Preserve the reference's refined rounded Chinese hand-painted fantasy art: precise polished contours, full rounded shapes, rich but restrained painterly detail, convincing cloth/stone/foliage volumes, jade and teal landscape, ivory cloth, warm gold accents, clean air and soft depth. Luminous but properly exposed highlights. Premium 2D illustration, not flat vector or plastic 3D.
Character on the RIGHT THIRD: one small chibi Taoist boy, the same large brown eyes, rosy round face, short spiky brown hair, golden headband with knot and two ribbons, jade-green gold-trim vest over ivory robe and trousers, golden yin-yang gourd on belt. Big head and short limbs. Keep his face, hands and all important props within safe edges.
LEFT 45% stays comparatively quiet: softly layered distant scenery and mist or sky, suitable for future overlaid text, but do not paint any text. Foreground thematic props concentrate on the right. Do not place the character on the left.
ABSOLUTELY NO TEXT: no Chinese or English characters, pseudo-writing, numerals, calligraphy, watermark, logo, UI border, graphic frame. Plain lanterns and plain packets must have NO characters. No giant moon, mooncakes, rabbit or Mid-Autumn osmanthus. Change the scene to the festival below instead of copying the reference night setting.
Rendering goal: highest available refined finished painting; the host manages the model and quality.
Festival-specific scene: Theme: Flower Festival (花朝). Luminous spring garden in full bloom, pale peach and pink magnolias, soft ivory and blush peonies, restrained green foliage. On the right the boy carefully ties a plain narrow pink ribbon to a low flowering branch, with a little woven basket of fresh blossoms beside him. The ribbon has no writing. Soft petals drift lightly; quiet distant jade-roof garden pavilion, calm pool and teal mountain silhouettes on the left. Joyful appreciation of flowers, spacious refined composition rather than a wall of flowers; one boy only, no flower crown obscuring his golden headband.


Refinement constraints: Show the boy fully inside the canvas with two complete feet planted on the garden path. Both hands are clearly separated, naturally holding the two ends of the single pink ribbon at its knot on the low branch. Believable contact between fingers, ribbon and branch, anatomically coherent small hands, no extra fingers or limbs. Keep the same polished hand-painted face and garment treatment as image 1. The pink blossom clusters and ribbon are the focal festival cue; use a calm pale jade pool and soft distant mountains on the left, no prominent decorations across its text-safe center. Full-bleed horizontal scene with no border. Native pixel target 2098 by 749; keep the widest 2.8:1 composition available.

visualCheck.method: Actual view_image of final native file and actual viewing of both approved references; image display was scaled to 2048 x 731 by the viewer.
visualCheck.theme: Spring blossom garden, pink ribbons tied to flowering branches, flower basket, magnolias and peonies; Flower Festival appreciation/protection of blossoms reads clearly.
visualCheck.style: Rounded chibi boy, golden headband, large brown eyes, jade/ivory garments, warm gold gourd; polished hand-painted volumes and jade mountain atmosphere align with reference.
visualCheck.face: Eyes, pupils, mouth, cheeks and ears coherent; no obvious facial defect.
visualCheck.hands: Two separated hands hold ribbon close to its branch knot, with plausible grip and no obvious extra digits or fused limbs. Bent fingers overlap in the grip; all five fingers on each hand cannot be individually confirmed from this pose.
visualCheck.feet: Two complete shoes and legs remain visible inside the frame, planted on the path; no duplicate or detached feet.
visualCheck.propContact: Ribbon, knot, branch and hand grip read coherently; flower basket rests on ground and gourd hangs from belt.
visualCheck.negativeSpace: Left lake and atmospheric landscape are quieter than the right figure/flowers. It is scenic rather than empty; detailed pavilions remain at the edges and background.
visualCheck.text: No readable Chinese/English text, watermark, numerals, UI frame or pseudo-lettering observed. Pink ribbons have subtle decorative floral marks.
visualCheck.exposure: Ivory cloth and light petals retain folds and volume; no broad blown-out region observed.
visualCheck.layout: Right-side character, ribbon action and flower basket; full-bleed wide banner.

independentReview.note: Theme, style, face, ribbon contact, two feet, quiet left lake, no text and exposure passed. Bent/occluded fingers cannot all be independently counted.
